description: One person's named filter-and-sort combination on a listing surface. Generic by construction: the surface is a Dynamic Link, so the same preset serves a Smart View, a native list, or anything else that lists records.

fields.label: User
fields.description: A preset is personal. It is never shared and never public — the surface it sits on carries its own sharing rules.

fields.label: Reference Doctype
fields.description: Which kind of surface this preset belongs to — CRM Smart View for a view, CRM Lead for the leads list.

fields.label: Reference Name
fields.description: The one surface it belongs to. BLANK means the whole list of that doctype, which is what a native list view is.

fields.label: Filters
fields.description: The surface's own filter shape, as JSON. Stored, never interpreted here — a preset remembers an answer, it does not know what the answer means.

fields.label: Sort
fields.description: The surface's own sort shape, as JSON. Columns are deliberately NOT remembered: on a Smart View the column set IS the view.

name: CRM Filter Preset
